name: Gargolyn IV
description: Gargolyn IV was a planet known to be a garden paradise that was lush with animal life and vegetation. It was the homeworld of the Cor species. The land of the Cors was guarded by a huge beast that destroyed any settlement the scouting Karflo Corporation initiated.
